subject: Logic
title: Maxwell's Demon
description: A quick win: understand Maxwell's Demon.

hook.text: A tiny demon guards a door between two gas chambers, sorting fast molecules from slow. Free energy from nothing.

buildup.text: James Clerk Maxwell proposed this in 1867 to challenge the second law of thermodynamics.

discovery.text: If the demon could work for free, entropy would decrease—violating the most fundamental law of physics.

twist.text: The resolution took 100 years: measuring molecules requires information, and erasing information generates heat.

climax.text: Landauer proved it: forgetting a bit of information costs a minimum amount of energy. The demon pays after all.

quiz.question: How was Maxwell's demon resolved?
options: Processing and erasing information has an energy cost
